package.name: fusion_msgs
package.description:
Messages for the track-level object fusion stack: a common per-sensor measurement type and the fused track output.
A SEPARATE package from perception_msgs on purpose. Adding these to perception_msgs would mean editing its CMakeLists, and that package is what radar_ros and the running /tracked_objects depend on. A new sibling costs nothing and keeps TrackedObject.msg's type hash unquestionably stable.
